summary: CR-385 v2.19 Extend Stay end-to-end frontend testing on cr385-frontdesk-mockup.html at 1920x800. Verified entry from In-House and Departures Extend buttons, form layout, current-stay summary, new check-out with min=cout+1 and auto nights, same-room availability line, conflict path on EVEN room + auto-suggested pre-selected same-type room (★), progress chips ('Room moved'), live bill (charge/SGST/CGST/total/folio-after), Discount (percent 10% → -660 line, reason gating), Settle pills (Add to folio vs Collect now), advance fields (method + UTR gating for UPI), readiness/confirm gating, confirm toast performing the room move ('Stay extended · Room 229 → 20 Sep · moved to Room 229 · advance ₹2,000 collected'), form close, and NO-SCROLL invariant in the busiest state. Regressions for ?booking=1, ?bill=103, ?checkin=a2 still render unchanged. No JS console errors.

test_evidence.odd_room_101_plus1: extend-room-status green '✓ Room 101 is free through 17 Sep — no move needed.', no picker, confirm enabled
test_evidence.even_room_102_plus1_no_conflict: green status ('free through 18 Sep'); confirms na=cout+1 rule: conflict only when newCout > cout+1
test_evidence.even_room_102_plus3_conflict: red '⚠ Room 102 has an arrival on 18 Sep — a room move is required', extend-room-picker shown with 4 pills, room 229 ★ pre-selected and aria-pressed=true, extend-progress-room='✓ Room moved'
test_evidence.discount_10pct_no_reason: discount-line=₹-660, sgst/cgst=₹148.5 each, total=₹6,237, folio-after=₹8,387, readiness='To complete: Discount reason', confirm DISABLED
test_evidence.discount_with_reason: readiness='Ready to extend · added to folio', confirm ENABLED
test_evidence.collect_now_upi_2000_no_utr: advance fields visible, folio-after=₹6,387, readiness='To complete: Txn / UTR no. for UPI', confirm DISABLED
test_evidence.confirm_toast: Stay extended · Room 229 → 20 Sep · moved to Room 229 · advance ₹2,000 collected

critical_code_review_comments: Minor cosmetic: after exConfirm(), g.room is updated to the new room BEFORE building the toast, so the string reads 'Room 229 → 20 Sep · moved to Room 229' — mentions the destination room twice. Consider capturing the original room in a local before mutation so it reads 'Room 102 → 20 Sep · moved to Room 229'.

extend-progress-date defaults to '✓ Dates' on load because the default draft.newCout = cout+1 which is already > cout; visually there is never a 'pending dates' state unless the user clears the date. Acceptable but worth noting.

File cr385-frontdesk-mockup.html is 776 lines with heavy inline logic; long-term the extend/checkin/booking/checkout forms would benefit from being split for maintainability (not a blocker for a mocked HTML).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Extend Stay v2.19 verified in full including conflict path (EVEN room + newCout > cout+1), suggested room pre-selection, discount reason gating, UPI UTR gating, and no-scroll invariant at 1920x800 (378/378, button bottom 770). Toast includes a minor redundancy where source room shows the already-updated destination room number; not part of requested checks.
